# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 8 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalent)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 1QH (Cave 1), Col. 8 | **Condition:** Better preserved

---

**8:1** They push their roots toward the underground stream; the trunk opens up to the living water.

**8:2** And it becomes a source that never dries up. And on its leafy branches all the forest creatures feed.

**8:3** Its base gets trampled by every traveler on the road, and birds perch on its branches.

**8:4** And all the waterside trees tower above it, because they shoot up tall wherever they are planted.

**8:5** But they never drive their roots down to the deep water source.

**8:6** And the shoot that produces the sacred seed for the planting of truth goes unnoticed and unvalued.

**8:7** And the mystery locked within its seal remains unknown — yet You, O God, have protected its fruit.

**8:8** With the hidden power of mighty warriors and holy spirits and the whirling sword of flame.

**8:9** And no one [...] will reach the fountain of life, or drink alongside the eternal trees.

**8:10** The sacred waters are untouchable, and no outsider can bear fruit with the heavenly planting.

**8:11** Because such a person looks but cannot truly see, and thinks but cannot bring themselves to trust the fountain of life.

**8:12** And I [...] became food for the flooding currents. But the fruit-bearing tree will stretch its branches toward [...].

**8:13** And the shoot of the everlasting planting across all the [...] will root itself.

**8:14** And it will spread its shade across the whole earth, and its [...] will touch the clouds.

**8:15** And its roots will reach the abyss. And all the rivers of Eden [...] will water its branches.

**8:16** And it will become [...] a vast forest of great trees, and the reach of its planting will extend across the entire world.

**8:17** Without boundary, past everything [...] all the way to the underworld. And the fountain of light will become an everlasting wellspring.

**8:18** That never runs dry. In its blazing sparks all the children of [...] will catch fire.

**8:19** And it will become a conflagration that burns every guilty person to ashes.

**8:20** And those who had pledged to support my testimony let themselves be talked into following the misinterpreters.

**8:21** For the wicked plotted against me, to swap out Your Teaching that You had written on my heart.

**8:22** For crowd-pleasing words to Your people. And they cut off the thirsty from the waters of knowledge.

**8:23** And for their thirst they hand them vinegar, so they will stare at their own delusions.

**8:24** And go wild at their parties and walk right into their traps.

**8:25** But You, O God, reject every strategy Belial devises, and Your plan is the one that will prevail.

**8:26** And the intention of Your heart is the one that lasts forever.

**8:27** And those imposters — they cook up Belial's schemes, and they come to You with split loyalties.

**8:28** And they have no grounding in Your truth. There is a poisonous root growing in the soil of their thoughts.

**8:29** And with stubborn hearts they look around and search for You among worthless idols.

**8:30** And they prop up the very thing that trips them right in front of their own faces.

**8:31** And they come seeking answers from You through the mouths of lying prophets who have been duped by falsehood.

**8:32** And then they babble [...] to Your people in garbled speech and a foreign tongue.

**8:33** Making all their efforts foolish through trickery. For they never chose [...] Your [...]

**8:34** And they refused to listen to Your word, because they said about the vision of knowledge: That cannot be trusted.

**8:35** And about the way of Your heart: That is not the right path.

**8:36** But You, O God, will respond to them, judging them with Your power according to the idols they chase.

**8:37** And for the sheer volume of their sins, so they get caught in the very traps they set — the ones who abandoned Your covenant.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 8 continues the visionary planting imagery before plunging back into betrayal. The "Torah written on my heart" (8:21) is one of the most theologically loaded phrases in the Hodayot, directly claiming Jeremiah 31:33's new covenant. The fire-of-light-becoming-fire-of-judgment motif (8:17-19) is extraordinary eschatological imagery.*
